mfa.deviceNameHint: To tell your devices apart, e.g. “iPhone” or “Shop tablet”.

enroll.title: Protect your account
enroll.intro: Besides the email code, you will also sign in with a code from an authenticator app. So nobody else gets into your account, even if they see your email.

download.title: Download an authenticator app
download.body: E.g. Google Authenticator or Microsoft Authenticator. On iPhone you can also use the built-in “Passwords”.

scan.title: Scan the QR code
scan.body: From another device, scan the code with the authenticator app. On this phone, tap “Open in the authenticator app” or copy the key.
scan.qrAlt: QR code for the authenticator app
scan.noQr: The QR code cannot be shown here. Use the key.

code.title: Enter the 6-digit code
code.body: Enter the code the authenticator app shows now for Anaklo.

errors.invalidCode: The code is not correct. Enter the one the app shows now.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a little and try again.
errors.nameTaken: There is already a device with this name.
errors.nameRequired: Enter a name for the device.
errors.copyFailed: Copying did not work. Type the key by hand.

secondDevice.title: Add a second device
secondDevice.body: If you lose this phone, you will sign in with the code of the second device.
secondDevice.hint: Put the authenticator app on a second device of yours too, e.g. a tablet or another phone, with another name.
secondDevice.confirm: I understand that if I lose this device I will need Nous

challenge.title: Code from the authenticator app
challenge.body: Enter the 6-digit code the authenticator app shows now.

lostDevice.title: Lost your device?
lostDevice.secondDeviceHint: If you added a second device, sign in with its code.
lostDevice.contact: Otherwise contact Nous. We will confirm that it is you: we will send a code to your email and call you on the shop’s phone.
lostDevice.noBypass: The app has no other way in without the device.

blocked.title: Contact Nous
blocked.body: An authenticator device was removed from your account without going through the app. For your security, a new authenticator device can be added only after Nous confirms it is you.
blocked.contact: Email or call Nous. We will call you back on the shop phone we have on file and unlock it together. If you can, change your email password first.

stepUp.title: Confirm with a code
stepUp.body: To continue, enter the 6-digit code from the authenticator app.
stepUp.failed: It did not go through. Try again.

security.title: Security
security.intro: Your devices with the authenticator app and your sign-ins.
security.addIntro: The new device will give codes like your others.
security.lastDevice: Add another device first to remove this one.
security.singleBanner: You have only one authenticator device. If you lose it, you will need Nous.
security.replaceHint: To change devices, add the new one first, then remove the old one.
security.signOutAllHint: For when the app stayed open on a device you no longer have.
security.signOutAllConfirm: Every device will need a new sign-in, this one too.
security.signOutAllFailed: Signing out of the other devices was not confirmed. This device stays signed in; check your connection and try again.

loadErrorBody: Check your connection and try again.

login.title: Sign in
login.intro: Enter your email. We will send you a 6-digit code.
login.codeSentNeutral: If this email has an account, we have sent you a code.
login.errorNetwork: Cannot reach the server. Check your internet connection and try again.
login.errorTooManyRequests: Too many attempts. Wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorCodeInvalid: The code is wrong or has expired. Try again or ask for a new code.

noAccess.title: No access
noAccess.body: Your account does not belong to any business. Ask the owner to add you, or sign in with a different email.

install.title: Add to your Home Screen first
install.intro: Anaklo works as an app on your Home Screen. That is where you sign in and get notifications.
install.stepShare: Tap the Share button (the square with the arrow pointing up).
install.stepOpen: Open Anaklo from your Home Screen and sign in there.
install.note: Signing in here, in the browser, does not carry over to the app.

push.title: Notifications
push.intro: You will be notified of every new online booking, cancellation or change to your appointments.
push.statusOff: Notifications are off on this device.
push.statusOn: Notifications are on on this device.
push.statusDenied: Notifications are blocked. Change this in the device settings.
push.statusUnsupported: This device or browser does not support notifications.
push.statusNeedsInstall: Add the app to your Home Screen first.
push.statusFailed: Notifications did not load. Try again later.
push.statusRegisterFailed: Notifications were not turned on. Please try again.
push.testSent: Sent. It will arrive within seconds on each of your devices with notifications on.
push.testNotRegistered: Turn on notifications on this device first.
push.testFailed: The test notification was not sent. Try again.

settings.closuresHint: Public holidays, days off and days with other hours.
settings.timeOffHint: Holidays and absences of the staff.
settings.membersHint: Who has access to the app.

members.title: Members
members.intro: Who signs in to the app with their email, and with which role.
members.emailHint: They sign in with this email: a code arrives every time.
members.staffHint: If they work in the calendar, choose who they are.

members.copyFailed: Not copied. Press and hold the text to copy it.

consequences.signOut: They will be signed out on all their devices.
consequences.dropDevices: Their code devices will be deleted.
consequences.enroll: At their next sign-in they will set up an authenticator app.

members.roleUnchanged: The role was already this one.
members.removeKeepsStaff: The professional «{{name}}» stays in the calendar.
members.notMember: They were no longer a member of the business.

identity.title: Business identity
identity.intro: The address of the booking page, the time zone and the currency of the business.
identity.slugHint: {{url}} · lower-case Latin letters, digits and hyphens

consequences.slug: Links already sent keep working and lead to the new address. The old address will never be given to another business.
consequences.timezone: Hours and closures keep the same local times. Time off keeps the same moment, so its local time changes. Not possible while there are future appointments.
consequences.currency: Amounts will be shown in the new currency without conversion. Not possible while there are future appointments.

closures.title: Closures and special days
closures.intro: Days when the shop or a professional is closed or works other hours.
closures.empty: No closure or special hours from today on.
closures.kindSpecialHint: Replaces the weekly hours of these days. For the whole shop it applies to everyone without their own, even on their day off.
closures.noteHint: Optional, e.g. “Public holiday”. Whole shop only.

errors.overlap: There is already a closure or special hours on one of these days.
errors.fromPast: Choose today or a future day.
errors.toBeforeFrom: The last day cannot be before the first.
errors.tooManyDays: Up to {{max}} days at a time.

timeOff.title: Time off
timeOff.intro: Holidays and absences of the staff. While someone is off, no appointments are booked with them.
timeOff.empty: There is no current or future time off.
timeOff.staffFixed: For another professional, delete this time off and add a new one.
timeOff.conflicts_one: {{count}} appointment falls in this time off.
timeOff.conflicts_other: {{count}} appointments fall in this time off.

errors.overlap: The professional already has time off in this period.
errors.endPast: The time off must end later than now.
errors.tooLong: A time off lasts at most 366 days.

policy.bookingEnabledOff: The booking page does not accept bookings.
policy.slotStepHint: How many minutes apart free times are offered.
policy.minNoticeHint: How early an online appointment must be booked.
policy.maxAdvanceHint: How many days ahead the page accepts bookings.
policy.cancelNoticeHint: Before the appointment time, with the SMS link.
policy.autoCompleteHint: After it ends, an appointment without a mark counts as “Came”.
policy.correctionWindowHint: For how many days the staff can change “Came” and “No-show”.
policy.allowAnyStaffHint: The client may skip choosing a professional.
policy.messagingEnabledHint: Confirmations and cancellations are always sent.
policy.replanHint: Waiting reminders follow the new settings; any that should already have gone out are not sent.

errors.quietWindow: Quiet hours last from 1 to 12 hours.

conflicts.intro: Appointments in a closure, in time off or outside the hours. Reassign them to a colleague or cancel them.
conflicts.notFreeAnymore: The colleague is no longer free.

absence.allResolved: Every appointment is taken care of.

errors.endBeforeStart: The end must be after the start.
